## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release gate must fail closed before merge: when the results file is missing, `load_results` now returns an empty list, so `release_allowed` approves the release even though no checks were run.

## Changes
The pull request makes `load_results` return `[]` when the results file is missing. It also adds `display_preferences`, which defaults to a light theme when no preferences file exists, and adds tests for both functions.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Fail closed when the results file is missing — When `results.json` is absent, `load_results` returns `[]`, and `release_allowed` at `app/results.py:12` evaluates `all([])`, which is `True`. The gate cannot tell "every saved check passed" apart from "no checks were saved". — Any deployment that is missing its results file, for example because the check step never ran or a path is misconfigured, passes the release gate with no evidence. — Fix: Let `FileNotFoundError` propagate from `load_results` (or have `release_allowed` return `False` when no results exist), then add a missing-file case to `test_saved_checks_control_release`.
